candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization ReadTimeout: gateway->order->payment spans show ~2s transport ReadTimeout on POST payment /v1/authorizations, while inventory/redis calls succeed. Order and checkout return 502 after ~2s, matching the observed 2015-2047ms durations.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency cause (saturation vs network) not established; logs excluded. Traces show payment timeouts but no payment service metrics.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed, and checkout/order return 502 at ~2s matching alert durations. Metrics show ~80% of /v1/checkout as 502 with p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment path. Bounded to downstream payment latency; payment-internal cause unproven.
